name: Meridian Performance
_base_url_note: PRODUCTION DOMAIN. Leave empty until the domain is connected, then set e.g. "https://www.yourdomain.com" (no trailing slash). This one value fills canonical URLs, og:url, og:image, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and all structured-data URLs. You can also pass it at build time: python3 build.py --base-url=https://www.yourdomain.com

business.name: Meridian Performance
business.description: Personalized training, nutrition and accountability coaching with Chance Dyck in Del Mar, CA, and online.

_social_note: Paste each full profile URL (https://...) into social.facebook / social.instagram / social.linkedin. They are used by the footer icons, the Contact page icons and the structured data (sameAs). To add YouTube later: fill social.youtube and add "youtube" to social_order.
